if you think it’s as easy conjuring up 海伦
as that phantom paper money.
Well now, [’m at your service
when it comes to producing witchy witches
and ghostly ghosts,
not to mention goiter-deformed dwarves;
but the Devil’s darlings,
while not to be dismissed lightly,
wont pass muster for classical heroines.

@@U02629@@
There you go again,
grinding out the same old tune!
There’s never any certainty dealing with you.
You're the father of all hindrances,
and for every remedy you want a new reward.
I know how it works:
you mumble a few words, and presto, it’s done,
even before I’ve turned around to look.

@@U02631@@
Those pagans don't concern me.
They have their own sort of Hell.
But there is a means—

@@U02633@@
Tell me! Tell me xow!

@@U02635@@
These are higher mysteries.
I do so reluctantly.
Goddesses are enthroned in sublime solitude,
outside time,
outside space—
even to speak of them embarrasses me.
They are the Mothers!
RAUCH. PART wor * 255
translation:
@@U02627@@
如果你认为海伦很容易被唤起
就像那张幻影纸币一样。
现在好了，[随时为您服务
当谈到生产巫术女巫时
和幽灵般的鬼魂，
更不用说甲状腺肿大而畸形的矮人了；
但魔鬼的宠儿，
虽然不能轻易忽视，
不会通过古典女主角的考验。

@@U02629@@
又来了，
磨出同样的老调！
与你打交道从来没有任何确定性。
你是一切障碍之父，
对于每一种补救措施，你都希望得到新的奖励。
我知道它是如何工作的：
你咕哝了几句，然后就完成了，
甚至在我转身看之前。

@@U02631@@
那些异教徒与我无关。
他们有自己的地狱。
但有一个办法——

@@U02633@@
告诉我！告诉我xow！

@@U02635@@
这些都是更高的奥秘。
我很不情愿地这样做。
女神们在崇高的孤独中登基，
外面的时间，
外部空间——
甚至谈论它们都让我感到尴尬。
她们是母亲！
劳赫。部分工作 * 255
